column1: # Exception list of tools/material_compare.py: intended differences between the
# engine and the retail path. Every row is counted in the report; nothing is
# dropped silently. New rows need the approval of the maintainers, and of the
# owner of the look when they hide a visible difference. Not allowed here:
# mosaic cells, animated textures, draw paths the engine does not rebuild,
# LOD headers only as the decided row lod-header below.
# Columns (tab separated):
#   id         unique name (a-z, 0-9, -)
#   src        * or source letters joined by | (T I D X S W M)
#   feature    * or features joined by | (prim anim lod page depth clut uv blend
#              col stage cell missing-source engine-only-material engine-only
#              sample-outside); a deviation is covered only when the row names
#              ALL its features. '-' = documentation row: names something the
#              tool does not compare and covers nothing.
#   condition  - or terms joined by ';', all must hold:
#              r.KEY / e.KEY / f.KEY with = != ~ (glob) !~, or r.KEY alone (present),
#              !r.KEY (absent). r = retail line, e = engine line (or nearest
#              engine candidate), f = frame (tag level container view track
#              raceFrame). KEY = page depth clut uv blend cell srcId sub or an
#              extra key.
#   reason     why the difference is intended (at least 20 characters)
id
sky-look
column5: Sky look: the engine draws the sky with its own shader (look accepted by screenshot); the PS1 sky gradient and its primitives are not rebuilt.

column1: water-look
column5: Water look: the engine draws water with its own shader (look accepted by screenshot); the PS1 water tricks are not rebuilt.

column1: hires-driver
column5: Hi-res drivers: the engine reads the driver's own hi-res texture instead of a VRAM page (engine lines marked hires=1), so page, CLUT and UV have no VRAM values to compare. Hi-res is off in the proof run, where this row covers 0.

column1: depth-offset
column5: Depth offset of coplanar layers: the engine orders coplanar faces with a depth offset per material instead of the ordering table. It changes depth order only; no compared field depends on it.

column1: lod-header
column5: Model LOD: the engine draws the finest model header (header 0) at every distance - decided for the PC version on 2026-10-16; retail picks a coarser header by distance. Textures of header 0 are still compared wherever retail draws header 0.

column1: track-geomorph
column5: Track colour morph by distance: the engine shows the finest stage of the track colours at every distance - decided for the PC version on 2026-10-16; retail morphs the vertex colours of distant blocks (retail lines marked morph=1). Only the colour of such lines is covered; page, CLUT, UV, blend, cell and stage are still compared.
